digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler mode and advisory lock
propositions: Inherited str lexical comparisons in Mode incorrectly rank higher modes, causing bootstrap-throttle > reconcile-check to evaluate false instead of true.
The complete five-mode MODE_CAPS mapping (reconcile-check=0, dry-run=0, bootstrap-strict=10, bootstrap-throttle=100, live=None) must be directly asserted in test coverage.
Advisory-lock phase-gate round-trip through real ref backend must allow equal reconcile-check target while blocking higher targets.
Rich comparison operators in Mode must use explicit five-mode rank order rather than inherited str lexical ordering.
All legacy mode strings, caps, from_str behavior, CLI vocabulary, MCP payloads, workflow inputs, and persisted gate values must remain unchanged for backward compatibility.
